units.zh: 郭秀 和士開 穆提婆 高阿那肱 韓鳳 韓寶業等
units.en: Guo Xiu, He Shikai, Mu Tipo, Gao Anagujin, Han Feng, Han Baoye, and the like
units.literal: Guo Xiu, He Shikai, Mu Tipo, Gao Anagujin, Han Feng, Han Baoye, and others

units.zh: 甚哉齊末之嬖幸也，蓋書契以降未之有焉。
units.en: Never in recorded history had a dynasty's closing years seen favorites like those of Qi.
units.literal: How extreme were the favored minions at the end of Qi! Since the invention of writing, nothing like it had ever existed.

units.zh: 心利錐刀，居台鼎之任；
units.en: With hearts as keen as blades for profit, they occupied the highest offices of state;
units.literal: Hearts sharp as awls and knives, they held the posts of chief ministers;

units.zh: 智昏菽麥，當機衡之重。
units.en: yet with minds too dim to tell beans from wheat, they shouldered the empire's decisive authority.
units.literal: minds confused about beans and wheat, they bore the weight of the empire's pivot.

units.zh: 刑殘閹宦、蒼頭盧兒，西域醜胡、龜茲雜伎，封王者接武，開府者比肩。
units.en: Castrated eunuchs, menial slaves, grotesque Western barbarians, and Kucha acrobats were enfeoffed as kings in succession and granted grand prefectures one beside another.
units.literal: Mutilated eunuchs, house slaves and lackeys, ugly barbarians from the Western Regions and assorted Kucha performers—those enfeoffed as kings followed one after another, those granted grand prefectures stood shoulder to shoulder.

units.zh: 非直獨守弄臣，且復多干朝政。
units.en: They were not only imperial playthings but frequently meddled in government.
units.literal: They were not merely kept as playthings of the ruler, but also often meddled in court affairs.

units.zh: 賜予之費，帑藏以虛；
units.en: Imperial largesse drained the state coffers bare;
units.literal: The cost of gifts and grants emptied the treasury;

units.zh: 杼軸之資，剝掠將盡。
units.en: and the people's last resources were plundered nearly to nothing.
units.literal: the resources of the loom and spindle were stripped almost clean.

units.zh: 縱龜鼎之祚，卜世靈長，屬此淫昏，無不亡之理，齊運短促，固其宜哉。
units.en: Though heaven's mandate might promise long life for a dynasty, under such depravity collapse was inevitable; that Qi's star burned so briefly was only fitting.
units.literal: Even if the tortoise-and-cauldron mandate promised long-lasting reign, under such licentious folly there was no way the state would not perish—Qi's brief fortune was only what one should expect.

units.zh: 高祖、世宗，情存庶政，文武任寄，多貞幹之臣，唯郭秀小人，有累明德。
units.en: Under Gaozu and Shizong, government still had substance and upright men filled military and civil posts—only the petty Guo Xiu tarnished their good name.
units.literal: Gaozu and Shizong still cared for common governance; in the civil and military posts they employed many upright, resolute ministers—only the petty man Guo Xiu marred their bright virtue.

units.zh: 天保五年之後，雖罔念作狂，所幸之徒，唯左右驅馳，內外褻狎，其朝廷之事一不與聞。
units.en: After Tianbao 5, though the emperor abandoned restraint, his favorites were merely runners and intimates who never heard a word of state business.
units.literal: After the fifth year of Tianbao, though he forgot virtue and ran wild, those he favored were only attendants who raced to his side; intimate inside and out, they heard nothing at all of court affairs.

units.zh: 大寧之後，姦佞浸繁，盛業鴻基，以之顛覆。
units.en: After Daning, flatterers multiplied until they toppled the dynasty's great foundation.
units.literal: After Daning, treacherous flatterers multiplied; the great enterprise and broad foundation were overturned by them.

units.zh: 生民免夫被發左袵，非不幸也。
units.en: That the people were spared barbarian subjugation was no calamity.
units.literal: That the common people were spared the disheveled hair and left lapel—that was no misfortune.

units.zh: 今緝諸凶族為《佞幸傳》云。
units.en: I have now compiled their accounts into the Biographies of Favored Minions.
units.literal: Now I have compiled these wicked clans into the "Biographies of Favored Minions."

units.zh: 其宦者之徒，尤是亡齊之一物。
units.en: The eunuchs were especially among the instruments of Qi's ruin.
units.literal: As for the eunuchs among them, they were especially one cause of Qi's destruction.

units.zh: 醜聲穢跡，千端萬緒，其事闕而不書，仍略存姓名，附之此《傳》之末。
units.en: Their vile deeds were too numerous to record in full; I have listed only their names at the end of this biography.
units.literal: Their foul reputations and filthy deeds were myriad; those affairs are omitted from writing, but names are briefly preserved and appended at the end of this biography.

units.zh: 其帝家諸奴及胡人樂工，叨竊貴辛，今亦出焉。
units.en: Imperial slaves and barbarian musicians who usurped high rank are included as well.
units.literal: The various bondservants of the imperial house and foreign musicians who presumptuously seized noble rank are also included here.

units.zh: 郭秀，范陽涿人。
units.en: Guo Xiu was from Zhuo in Fanyang.
units.literal: Guo Xiu was a native of Zhuo in Fanyang.

units.zh: 事高祖為行臺右丞，親寵日隆，多受賂遺。
units.en: Serving Gaozu as Right Director of the Mobile Secretariat, he won ever greater personal favor and took bribes freely.
units.literal: He served Gaozu as Right Director of the Mobile Secretariat; the emperor's personal favor for him grew daily, and he frequently accepted bribes.

units.zh: 秀遇疾，高祖親臨視之，問所欲官。
units.en: When Xiu fell ill, Gaozu visited him in person and asked what post he wanted.
units.literal: When Xiu fell ill, Gaozu personally visited him and asked what office he desired.

units.zh: 乃啟為七兵尚書，除書未至而卒。
units.en: He asked to be made Director of the Seven Armies, but died before the appointment reached him.
units.literal: He requested appointment as Director of the Seven Armies; the commission had not arrived before he died.

units.zh: 家無成人子弟，高祖自至其宅，親使錄知其家資粟帛多少，然後去。
units.en: The family had no grown sons; Gaozu went to the house himself, had its grain and silk inventoried, and only then departed.
units.literal: His household had no adult sons or younger brothers; Gaozu went in person to his residence and had someone record how much grain, silk, and cloth the family possessed, and only then left.

units.zh: 命其子孝義與太原公已下同學讀書。
units.en: He had Xiu's son Xiaoyi study alongside the Prince of Taiyuan and his classmates.
units.literal: He ordered Xiu's son Xiaoyi to study together with the Prince of Taiyuan and those below him.

units.zh: 初，秀忌楊愔，誑脅令其逃亡。
units.en: Earlier, Xiu had resented Yang Yin and tricked and intimidated him into fleeing.
units.literal: Earlier, Xiu resented Yang Yin and deceived and threatened him into fleeing.

units.zh: 秀死後，愔還，高祖追忿秀，卽日斥孝義，終身不齒。
units.en: When Yin returned after Xiu's death, Gaozu, still angry at Xiu, that same day expelled Xiaoyi and never admitted him to polite society again.
units.literal: After Xiu died, Yin returned; Gaozu, reflecting angrily on Xiu, that very day cast out Xiaoyi and for life counted him unworthy of company.

units.zh: 和士開，字彥通，清都臨漳人也。
units.en: He Shikai, styled Yantong, was from Linzhang in Qingdu.
units.literal: He Shikai, courtesy name Yantong, was a native of Linzhang in Qingdu.

units.zh: 其先西域商胡，本姓素和氏。
units.en: His forebears were Western Region merchant aliens originally surnamed Suhe.
units.literal: His ancestors were merchant barbarians from the Western Regions; their original surname was Suhe.

units.zh: 父安，恭敏善事人，稍遷中書舍人。
units.en: His father An was deferential, clever, and adept at winning favor, and rose eventually to Palace Secretariat Draftsman.
units.literal: His father An was respectful, quick-witted, and skilled at pleasing people; he was gradually promoted to Palace Secretariat Draftsman.

units.zh: 魏孝靜嘗夜中與朝賢講集，命安看斗柄所指，安答曰：「臣不識北斗。」
units.en: Emperor Xiaojing of Wei once met with court worthies at night and asked An to read the Dipper's handle. An answered, "I do not know the Northern Dipper."
units.literal: Emperor Xiaojing of Wei once gathered with court worthies for discussion at night and ordered An to observe where the Dipper's handle pointed. An replied, "Your servant does not know the Northern Dipper."

units.zh: 高祖聞之，以為淳直。
units.en: Gaozu heard of it and took it for plain, honest speech.
units.literal: When Gaozu heard this, he regarded it as simple honesty.

units.zh: 後為儀州刺史。
units.en: He later became Inspector of Yizhou.
units.literal: Later he served as Inspector of Yizhou.

units.zh: 士開幼而聰慧，選為國子學生，解悟捷疾，為同業所尚。
units.en: Shikai was bright from boyhood; chosen for the Imperial Academy, he grasped lessons swiftly and was admired by his peers.
units.literal: Shikai was clever from childhood; selected as a student of the Imperial Academy, he was quick in comprehension and admired by his fellows.

units.zh: 天保初，世祖封長廣王，辟士開府行參軍。
units.en: Early in Tianbao, Shizu was made Prince of Changguang and took Shikai onto his staff as a traveling adjutant.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao, Shizu was enfeoffed as Prince of Changguang and recruited Shikai as a traveling adjutant in his princely staff.

units.zh: 世祖性好握槊，士開善於此戲，由是遂有斯舉。
units.en: Shizu loved polo, and Shikai's skill at the game opened the way to favor.
units.literal: Shizu loved the game of polo; Shikai excelled at this sport, and from this arose his advancement.

units.zh: 加以傾巧便僻，又能彈胡琵琶，因此親狎。
units.en: His sly flattery and skill on the barbarian pipa drew him ever closer to the prince.
units.literal: Add to this his sycophantic cleverness and deft flattery, and his ability to play the barbarian pipa—by these means he grew intimate with the prince.

units.zh: 嘗謂王曰：「殿下非天人也，是天帝也。」
units.en: He once told the prince, "Your Highness is no mortal—you are the Emperor of Heaven."
units.literal: He once said to the prince, "Your Highness is not a man of Heaven—you are the Emperor of Heaven."

units.zh: 王曰：「卿非世人也，是世神也。」
units.en: The prince replied, "You are no ordinary man—you are a spirit of this age."
units.literal: The prince said, "You are not a man of the world—you are a spirit of the world."

units.zh: 其深相愛如此。
units.en: Their mutual affection ran as deep as that.
units.literal: They loved each other deeply in this fashion.

units.zh: 顯祖知其輕薄，不令王與小人相親善，責其戲狎過度，徙長城。
units.en: Xianzu saw his frivolity and forbade the prince such company; rebuking their excessive horseplay, he sent Shikai to the Great Wall.
units.literal: Xianzu knew how frivolous he was and would not allow the prince to be friendly with such a petty man; rebuking him for excessive playful intimacy, he banished Shikai to the Great Wall garrison.

units.zh: 後除京畿士曹參軍，長廣王請之也。
units.en: He was later made Capital Region Personnel Adjutant at the Prince of Changguang's request.
units.literal: Later he was appointed Adjutant of the Capital Region Personnel Office at the Prince of Changguang's request.

units.zh: 世祖踐祚，累除侍中，加開府。
units.en: When Shizu took the throne, Shikai rose step by step to Attendant-in-Ordinary with the rank of Grand Prefect.
units.literal: When Shizu ascended the throne, Shikai was repeatedly promoted, finally to Attendant-in-Ordinary and Grand Prefect of the Palace.

units.zh: 遭母劉氏憂，帝聞而悲惋，遣武衛將軍呂芬詣宅，晝夜扶侍，成服後方還。
units.en: On mourning for his mother Lady Liu, the emperor grieved and sent General Lü Fen of the Martial Guards to wait on him day and night until the mourning period was complete.
units.literal: When he entered mourning for his mother, Lady Liu, the emperor heard and grieved; he sent General of Martial Guards Lü Fen to his house to attend him day and night, and Fen returned only after the mourning garments were completed.

units.zh: 其日，帝又遣以犢車迎士開入內，帝見，親自握手，愴惻下泣，曉喻良久，然後遣還，幷諸弟四人並起復本官。
units.en: That day he sent a calf carriage to bring Shikai inside; taking his hand, the emperor wept and comforted him at length before letting him go, and restored all four of Shikai's brothers to office as well.
units.literal: That same day the emperor again sent a calf-drawn carriage to bring Shikai into the palace; upon seeing him, the emperor personally took his hand, wept in deep sorrow, and counseled him at length before sending him back—and all four of his younger brothers were also recalled and restored to their former offices.

units.zh: 其見親重如此。
units.en: Such was the depth of favor he enjoyed.
units.literal: Such was the degree of his favor and esteem.

units.zh: 除右僕射。
units.en: He was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
units.literal: He was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

units.zh: 帝先患氣疾，因飲酒輒大發動，士開每諫不從。
units.en: The emperor had a chronic choleric illness that drinking always aggravated; Shikai remonstrated repeatedly, but the emperor refused to heed him.
units.literal: The emperor had long suffered from a choleric complaint; drinking would always set off severe attacks. Shikai admonished him each time, but the emperor would not listen.

units.zh: 屬帝氣疾發，又欲飲，士開淚下歔欷不能言。
units.en: Once, as the illness flared and the emperor reached again for wine, Shikai wept silently and could not speak.
units.literal: When the emperor's choleric illness flared and he wished to drink again, Shikai wept and sobbed, unable to speak.

units.zh: 帝曰：「卿此是不言之諫。」
units.en: The emperor said, "This is admonition without words."
units.literal: The emperor said, "This is your admonition without words."

units.zh: 因不復飲。
units.en: He put the cup aside and drank no more.
units.literal: And so he drank no more.

units.zh: 言辭容止，極諸鄙褻，以夜繼晝，無復君臣之禮。
units.en: His words and manners sank to the lowest vulgarity; day ran into night with no trace of the rites between ruler and minister.
units.literal: In speech and bearing he was utterly base and indecent; night followed day without any observance of the rites between ruler and minister.

units.zh: 至說世祖云：「自古帝王，盡為灰燼，堯、舜、桀、紂，竟復何異？
units.en: He even told Shizu, "Every emperor since antiquity ends as ashes—what difference between Yao, Shun, Jie, and Zhou?
units.literal: He even told Shizu, "Emperors from ancient times have all turned to ash—what difference in the end between Yao, Shun, Jie, and Zhou?

units.zh: 陛下宜及少壯，恣意作樂，縱橫行之，卽是一日快活敵千年。
units.en: While you are still young, indulge yourself without restraint—a single day of pleasure is worth a thousand years.
units.literal: Your Majesty should while you are still young indulge in pleasure as you please, roaming at will—a single day's joy equals a thousand years.

units.zh: 國事分付大臣，何慮不辦，無為自勤苦也。」
units.en: Leave government to the great ministers; it will be managed. Do not wear yourself out with toil."
units.literal: Leave state affairs to the great ministers—why worry they will not be handled? Do not torment yourself with labor."

units.zh: 世祖大悅。
units.en: Shizu was delighted.
units.literal: Shizu was greatly pleased.

units.zh: 其年十二月，世祖寢疾於乾壽殿，士開入侍醫藥。
units.en: In the twelfth month of that year Shizu took to his bed in Qianshou Hall, and Shikai attended him with medicine.
units.literal: That December Shizu fell ill in Qianshou Hall; Shikai entered to attend him with medicine.

units.zh: 世祖謂士開有伊、霍之才，殷勤屬以後事，臨崩，握士開之手曰：「勿負我也。」
units.en: Shizu declared that Shikai had the gifts of Yi Yin and Huo Guang and earnestly entrusted the aftermath to him; dying, he clasped Shikai's hand and said, "Do not betray me."
units.literal: Shizu said Shikai had the talent of Yi Yin and Huo Guang and earnestly entrusted him with affairs after his death; on his deathbed he grasped Shikai's hand and said, "Do not fail me."

units.zh: 仍絕於士開之手。
units.en: He breathed his last still holding Shikai's hand.
units.literal: He then expired with his hand still in Shikai's.

units.zh: 後主以世祖顧托，深委仗之。
units.en: The Later Lord, honoring Shizu's deathbed charge, placed deep trust in him.
units.literal: The Later Lord, because of Shizu's deathbed trust, relied on him deeply.

units.zh: 又先得幸於胡太后，是以彌見親密。
units.en: He had already won Empress Dowager Hu's favor, and their intimacy only deepened.
units.literal: He had also won favor with Empress Dowager Hu earlier, and so grew all the more intimate.

units.zh: 趙郡王叡與婁定遠等謀出士開，引諸貴人共為計策。
units.en: Prince Rui of Zhao Commandery, with Lou Dingyuan and others, plotted to oust Shikai and summoned the great nobles to counsel together.
units.literal: Prince of Zhao Commandery Rui, together with Lou Dingyuan and others, plotted to remove Shikai and brought in the various nobles to plan together.

units.zh: 屬太后觴朝貴於前殿，叡面陳士開罪失，云：「士開先帝弄臣，城狐社鼠，受納貨賄，穢亂宮掖，臣等義無杜口，冒死以陳。」
units.en: As the empress dowager feasted the nobles in the front hall, Rui openly accused Shikai: "Shikai was the late emperor's favorite, a rat in the city wall—taking bribes and polluting the inner palace. We cannot in conscience stay silent and risk death to speak."
units.literal: When the empress dowager entertained the court nobles with wine in the front hall, Rui openly stated Shikai's crimes and faults, saying, "Shikai was the late emperor's plaything, a rat nesting under the city wall—accepting bribes and defiling the inner palace. We are bound by duty not to hold our tongues and risk death to speak out."

units.zh: 太后曰：「先帝在時，王等何不道？
units.en: The empress dowager said, "When the late emperor lived, why did you not say this?
units.literal: The empress dowager said, "When the late emperor was alive, why did Your Highnesses not speak?

units.zh: 今日欲欺孤寡耶！
units.en: Do you mean to bully a widow and a child today!
units.literal: Do you wish to deceive a widow and orphan today!

units.zh: 但飲酒，勿多言。」
units.en: Drink your wine and say no more."
units.literal: Just drink—do not say more."

units.zh: 叡詞色愈厲。
units.en: Rui's tone and bearing turned fiercer still.
units.literal: Rui's words and expression grew harsher still.

units.zh: 或曰：「不出士開，朝野不定。」
units.en: Someone said, "Unless Shikai goes, court and realm will never be secure."
units.literal: Someone said, "Unless Shikai is removed, court and country will not be settled."

units.zh: 叡等或投冠於地，或拂衣而起，言詞咆勃，無所不至。
units.en: Some threw down their caps, others stormed away; their words grew violent beyond measure.
units.literal: Rui and the others either flung their caps to the ground or swept their robes and rose; their words were raging and unrestrained.

units.zh: 明日，叡等共詣雲龍門，令文遙入奏之，太后不聽。
units.en: The next day they went to the Cloud Dragon Gate and had Wen Yao submit a memorial; the empress dowager refused to hear it.
units.literal: The next day Rui and the others went together to the Cloud Dragon Gate and had Wen Yao enter to memorialize; the empress dowager would not listen.

units.zh: 段韶呼胡長粲傳言，太后曰：「梓宮在殯，事大拚速，欲王等更思量。」
units.en: Duan Shao sent Hu Changcan with a message: the empress dowager said, "The late emperor's coffin is still in mourning—this is no time for rash action. I ask you to think again."
units.literal: Duan Shao summoned Hu Changcan to convey a message; the empress dowager said, "The imperial coffin still lies in state—the matter is too urgent to be hasty. I wish Your Highnesses to reconsider."

units.zh: 趙郡王等遂並拜謝，更無餘言。
units.en: The Prince of Zhao and the rest bowed in apology and said nothing further.
units.literal: The Prince of Zhao and the others then all bowed in thanks and said nothing more.

units.zh: 太后及後主召見問士開，士開曰：「先帝群官之中，待臣最重，陛下諒暗始爾，大臣皆有覬覦心，若出臣，正是剪陛下羽翼。
units.en: The empress dowager and Later Lord questioned Shikai. He said, "Of all the late emperor's officials, none was favored as I was. Your Majesty has only just entered mourning, and the great ministers already eye power hungrily. Remove me, and you clip Your Majesty's own wings.
units.literal: The empress dowager and Later Lord summoned Shikai and questioned him. Shikai said, "Among all the late emperor's officials, none was treated more generously than I. Your Majesty has only just begun mourning, and the great ministers already harbor covetous designs. If you remove me, you will precisely be clipping the wings of Your Majesty.

units.zh: 宜謂叡等云：『令士開為州，待過山陵，然後發遣。』
units.en: Tell Rui and the others: 'Make Shikai a provincial inspector and send him off after the tomb rites.'
units.literal: You should tell Rui and the others, 'Appoint Shikai to a provincial post; after the imperial burial, then send him away.'

units.zh: 叡等謂臣真出，必心喜之。」
units.en: They will think I am truly being sent away and rejoice."
units.literal: Rui and the others, believing I am truly being sent out, will surely rejoice."

units.zh: 後主及太后然之，告叡等如士開旨，以士開為兗州刺史。
units.en: The Later Lord and empress dowager agreed, told Rui and the rest as Shikai advised, and made Shikai Inspector of Yan Province.
units.literal: The Later Lord and empress dowager agreed and told Rui and the others as Shikai advised, appointing Shikai Inspector of Yan Province.

units.zh: 山陵畢，叡等促士開就路。
units.en: After the burial, Rui and the others pressed Shikai to set out for his post.
units.literal: When the imperial tomb rites were complete, Rui and the others pressed Shikai to take up his post on the road.

units.zh: 士開載美女珠簾及條諸寶玩以詣定遠，謝曰：「諸貴欲殺士開，蒙王特賜性命，用作方伯。
units.en: Shikai loaded up women, pearl curtains, and other treasures and went to Dingyuan, saying, "The nobles meant to kill me; thanks to Your Highness sparing my life, I am made a regional governor.
units.literal: Shikai loaded beautiful women, pearl curtains, and various precious playthings and went to Dingyuan, saying in thanks, "The nobles wished to kill Shikai; thanks to Your Highness's special gift of life, I am made a regional governor.

units.zh: 今欲奉別，謹具上二女子、一珠簾。」
units.en: As I take my leave, I respectfully offer two women and a pearl curtain."
units.literal: Now wishing to take my leave, I respectfully present two women and one pearl curtain."

units.zh: 定遠喜，謂士開曰：「欲得還入不？」
units.en: Dingyuan was pleased and asked, "Do you want to go back inside?"
units.literal: Dingyuan was pleased and said to Shikai, "Do you wish to return inside?"

units.zh: 士開曰：「在內久，常不自安，令得出，實稱本意，不願更入，但乞王保護，長作大州刺史。
units.en: Shikai said, "Inside the palace I have long felt unsafe. Going out suits me—I do not wish to return, but only beg Your Highness's protection as inspector of a great province.
units.literal: Shikai said, "Within the palace I have long felt ill at ease. Now that I may leave, that truly suits my wish—I do not wish to return, but only beg Your Highness's protection that I may long serve as inspector of a great province.

units.zh: 今日遠出，願得一辭觀二宮。」
units.en: Before I depart, I ask only to bid farewell at the two palaces."
units.literal: Setting out far today, I wish only to take leave and visit the two palaces."

units.zh: 定遠許之。
units.en: Dingyuan consented.
units.literal: Dingyuan agreed.

units.zh: 士開由是得見太后及後主，進說曰：「先帝一旦登遐，臣愧不能自死。
units.en: Thus Shikai saw the empress dowager and Later Lord and pleaded, "When the late emperor died, I was ashamed that I did not die with him.
units.literal: By this means Shikai gained audience with the empress dowager and Later Lord and pleaded, "When the late emperor suddenly ascended to the distant realms, I was ashamed that I could not die with him.

units.zh: 觀朝貴勢欲陛下為幹明。
units.en: I see the court nobles mean to rule through Your Majesty as a figurehead,
units.literal: Seeing how the court nobles mean to make Your Majesty their puppet,

units.zh: 臣出之後，必有大變，復何面見先帝於地下。」
units.en: and once I am gone there will be grave turmoil—how could I face the late emperor in the grave?"
units.literal: after I am sent out there will surely be great upheaval—how could I face the late emperor beneath the earth?"

units.zh: 因慟哭。
units.en: He burst into tears.
units.literal: He then broke into anguished weeping.

units.zh: 帝及太后皆泣，問計將安出。
units.en: Emperor and empress dowager wept and asked what he would do.
units.literal: The emperor and empress dowager both wept and asked what plan he proposed.

units.zh: 士開曰：「臣已得入，復何所慮，正須數行詔書耳。」
units.en: Shikai said, "Now that I am inside again, what is there to fear? A few lines of edict will suffice."
units.literal: Shikai said, "Now that I am back inside, what is there to worry about? I need only a few lines of edict."

units.zh: 於是詔出定遠青州刺史，責趙郡王叡以不臣之罪，召入而殺之。
units.en: Edicts then sent Dingyuan to Qing Province, charged Prince Rui of Zhao with treason, summoned him in, and executed him.
units.literal: An edict then sent Dingyuan out as Inspector of Qing Province, charged Prince of Zhao Rui with the crime of disloyalty, summoned him in, and killed him.

units.zh: 復除士開侍中、右僕射。
units.en: Shikai was restored as Attendant-in-Ordinary and Right Vice Director.
units.literal: Shikai was again appointed Attendant-in-Ordinary and Right Vice Director.

units.zh: 定遠歸士開所遺，加以餘珍賂之。
units.en: Dingyuan returned Shikai's gifts and added more treasures to buy him off.
units.literal: Dingyuan returned what Shikai had given him and added further precious gifts to bribe him.

units.zh: 武平元年，封淮陽王，除尚書令、錄尚書事，復本官悉得如故。
units.en: In Wuping 1 he was made Prince of Huaiyang, Director of the Department of State Affairs, and Chief Recorder, with all former offices restored.
units.literal: In Wuping 1 he was enfeoffed as Prince of Huaiyang, appointed Director of the Department of State Affairs and Chief Recorder of the Department of State Affairs; all his former offices were restored as before.

units.zh: 世祖時，恒令士開與太后握槊，又出入臥內無復期限，遂與太后為亂。
units.en: Under Shizu, Shikai often played polo with the empress dowager and entered the inner quarters without restraint, eventually taking her as a lover.
units.literal: During Shizu's reign, Shikai was regularly made to play polo with the empress dowager; he also came and went in the sleeping quarters without limit, and eventually had an illicit affair with the empress dowager.

units.zh: 及世祖崩後，彌自放恣。
units.en: After Shizu's death he abandoned all restraint.
units.literal: After Shizu's death he grew ever more unrestrained.

units.zh: 瑯邪王儼惡之，與領軍庫狄伏連、侍中馮子琮、禦史王子宜、武衛高舍洛等謀誅之。
units.en: Prince Yan of Langye hated him and, with Army Director Kudie Fulian, Attendant Feng Zicong, Censor Wang Ziyi, Martial Guard Gao Shelou, and others, plotted his death.
units.literal: Prince of Langye Yan hated him and, with Army Director Kudie Fulian, Attendant-in-Ordinary Feng Zicong, Censor Wang Ziyi, and Martial Guard Gao Shelou and others, plotted to kill him.

units.zh: 伏連發京畿軍士，帖神武、千秋門外，並私約束，不聽士開入殿。
units.en: Fulian deployed capital troops outside the Shenwu and Qianqiu gates with secret orders to keep Shikai from the hall.
units.literal: Fulian mobilized capital-region troops and posted them outside the Shenwu and Qianqiu gates, with private orders not to let Shikai enter the hall.

units.zh: 其年七月二十五日旦，士開依式早參，伏連前把士開手曰：「今有一大好事。」
units.en: On the morning of the twenty-fifth day of the seventh month, Shikai came for the regular audience; Fulian seized his hand and said, "Today brings great good fortune."
units.literal: On the morning of the twenty-fifth day of the seventh month that year, Shikai came for the regular early audience; Fulian stepped forward and took Shikai's hand, saying, "Today there is a great piece of good news."

units.zh: 王子宜便授一函，云：「有勑令王向臺。」
units.en: Wang Ziyi handed him a sealed message: "There is an edict summoning the prince to the tribunal."
units.literal: Wang Ziyi at once handed him a packet, saying, "There is an edict ordering the prince to go to the tribunal."

units.zh: 遣兵士防送，禁於治書侍御廳事。
units.en: Soldiers escorted and detained him in the Supervising Censor's hall.
units.literal: Soldiers were sent to escort and guard him, confining him in the hall of the Supervising Censor.

units.zh: 儼遣都督馮永洛就臺斬之，時年四十八，簿錄其家口。
units.en: Yan sent Commander Feng Yongluo to behead him at the tribunal; he was forty-eight, and his household was registered and seized.
units.literal: Yan sent Commander Feng Yongluo to the tribunal to behead him; he was forty-eight years old, and his household register was seized for inventory.

units.zh: 後誅儼等。
units.en: Later Yan and his accomplices were put to death.
units.literal: Later Yan and the others were executed.

units.zh: 上哀悼，不視事數日，追憶不已。
units.en: The emperor grieved for days without holding court, unable to put Shikai from his mind.
units.literal: The emperor mourned, did not attend to affairs for several days, and could not cease remembering him.

units.zh: 詔起復其子道盛為常侍，又勑其弟士休入內省參典機密，詔贈士開假黃鉞、十州諸軍事、左丞相、太宰如故。
units.en: Edicts recalled Shikai's son Daosheng as Attendant-in-Ordinary, brought his brother Shi Xiu into the inner palace for state secrets, and posthumously invested Shikai with the yellow axe, ten-province military command, Left Chancellor, and Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: An edict recalled his son Daosheng from mourning as Attendant-in-Ordinary, ordered his brother Shi Xiu to enter the inner palace to participate in confidential affairs, and posthumously granted Shikai the yellow axe, command over ten provinces' military affairs, Left Chancellor, and Grand Preceptor as before.

units.zh: 士開稟性庸鄙，不闚書傳，發言吐論，惟以諂媚自資。
units.en: Shikai was coarse and ignorant of the classics; his only talent was flattery.
units.literal: Shikai was vulgar and base by nature, never looked into books or classics, and in speech and discourse relied solely on sycophancy.

units.zh: 河清、天統以後，威權轉盛，富商大賈朝夕填門，朝土不知廉恥者多相附會，甚者為其假子，與市道小人同在昆季行列。
units.en: From Heqing and Tiantong onward his power swelled; merchants thronged his gate, shameless officials fawned on him, some becoming adoptive sons and calling market lowlifes their brothers.
units.literal: After Heqing and Tiantong his authority grew ever greater; rich merchants filled his gate morning and night; many court officials lacking shame attached themselves to him, some even becoming his adoptive sons, standing in fraternal rank with market riffraff.

units.zh: 又有一人士，曾參士開，值疾，醫人云：「王傷寒極重，進藥無效，應服黃龍湯。」
units.en: Once when Shikai fell ill, a physician told a visitor, "The prince's cold is grave and the medicine is failing—he needs yellow dragon decoction."
units.literal: There was also a gentleman who had visited Shikai; when Shikai fell ill, the physician said, "My lord's cold damage is extremely severe; the medicine given has no effect—you should take yellow dragon decoction."

units.zh: 士開有難色。
units.en: Shikai looked uneasy.
units.literal: Shikai looked troubled.

units.zh: 是人云：「此物甚易與，王不須疑惑，請為王行先嘗之。」
units.en: The man said, "It is easily made, my lord—do not hesitate; let me taste it first for you."
units.literal: The man said, "This is very easy to prepare, my lord need not hesitate—I beg to taste it first on your behalf."

units.zh: 一舉便盡。
units.en: He drank it down at once.
units.literal: He drained it in one draft.

units.zh: 士開深感此心，為之強服，遂得汗病愈。
units.en: Moved by the gesture, Shikai took the dose, broke into sweat, and recovered.
units.literal: Shikai was deeply moved by this devotion, forced himself to take it, and broke into sweat and recovered from the illness.

units.zh: 其勢傾朝廷也如此。
units.en: Such was his dominance over the court.
units.literal: Such was the extent to which his power overshadowed the court.

units.zh: 雖以左道事之者，不問賢愚，無不進擢；
units.en: Those who courted him by any crooked means, wise or foolish, were always advanced;
units.literal: Though one served him by heterodox means, regardless of talent or folly, none failed to be promoted;

units.zh: 而以正理干忤者，亦頗能捨之。
units.en: yet he could also often overlook those who crossed him with honest argument.
units.literal: yet those who offended him with upright reasoning he could also often let go.

units.zh: 士開見人將加刑戮，多所營救，旣得免罪，卽命諷喻，責其珍寶，謂之贖命物。
units.en: When a man faced execution, Shikai often saved him—then sent word demanding jewels as "ransom for life."
units.literal: When Shikai saw someone about to be punished with execution, he often intervened to save him; once the sentence was remitted, he would send a hint demanding treasures, calling them ransom-for-life goods.

units.zh: 雖有全濟，皆非直道云。
units.en: Many lives were spared, but never by honest means.
units.literal: Though many were wholly spared, none of it was by the straight path, it is said.

units.zh: 穆提婆，本姓駱，漢陽人也。
units.en: Mu Tipo, originally surnamed Luo, was from Hanyang.
units.literal: Mu Tipo's original surname was Luo; he was a native of Hanyang.

units.zh: 父超，以謀叛伏誅。
units.en: His father Chao was put to death for treason.
units.literal: His father Chao was executed for plotting rebellion.

units.zh: 提婆母陸令萱賞配入掖庭，後主繈褓之中，令其鞠養，謂之乾阿妳，遂大為胡后所昵愛。
units.en: Tipo's mother Lu Lingxuan, sent to the inner palace as punishment, nursed the infant Later Lord and was called his dry nurse; Empress Hu doted on her.
units.literal: Tipo's mother Lu Lingxuan was sentenced and assigned to the inner palace; while the Later Lord was still in swaddling clothes she was made to nurse him, and was called his dry nurse, and came to be greatly favored by Empress Hu.

units.zh: 令萱姦巧多機辯，取媚百端，宮掖之中，獨擅威福。
units.en: Lingxuan was cunning and endlessly inventive in flattery; within the palace she alone held power and favor.
units.literal: Lingxuan was cunning, clever, and full of artful speech; she found a hundred ways to please and alone wielded authority and favor within the palace.

units.zh: 天統初，奏引提婆入侍後主，朝夕左右，大被親狎。
units.en: Early in Tiantong she had Tipo brought in to serve the Later Lord; he stayed at the emperor's side and won deep intimacy.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tiantong she memorialized to bring Tipo in to attend the Later Lord; day and night at his side, he was greatly favored and intimate.

units.zh: 嬉戲醜褻，無所不為。
units.en: Their games sank to every sort of obscene vulgarity.
units.literal: In horseplay he was obscene and vulgar beyond all bounds.

units.zh: 寵遇彌隆，官爵不知紀極，遂至錄尚書事，封城陽王。
units.en: His favor and rank swelled without limit until he became Chief Recorder and Prince of Chengyang.
units.literal: Favor grew ever greater; offices and ranks knew no limit, until he reached Chief Recorder of the Department of State Affairs and was enfeoffed as Prince of Chengyang.

units.zh: 令萱又佞媚，穆昭儀養之為母，是以提婆改姓穆氏。
units.en: Lingxuan flattered Consort Mu Zhao, who took her as a foster mother; Tipo therefore took the surname Mu.
units.literal: Lingxuan was also sycophantic; Consort Mu Zhao raised her as a mother, and for this reason Tipo changed his surname to Mu.

units.zh: 及穆后立，令萱號曰太姬，此卽齊朝皇后母氏之位號也，視第一品，班在長公主之上。
units.en: When Empress Mu was enthroned, Lingxuan received the title Grand Matron—the Qi rank for an empress's mother, first grade and above long princesses.
units.literal: When Empress Mu was established, Lingxuan was styled Grand Matron—this was the Qi court's title for an empress's mother, treated as first rank, ranking above long princesses.

units.zh: 自武平之後，令萱母子勢傾內外矣。
units.en: After Wuping, mother and son dominated court and palace.
units.literal: From Wuping onward, Lingxuan and her son's power overshadowed court and palace alike.

units.zh: 庸劣之徒皆重跡屏氣焉。
units.en: Lesser men trembled and held their tongues before them.
units.literal: Mediocre men all walked softly and held their breath before them.

units.zh: 自外殺生予奪不可盡言。
units.en: Their arbitrary power over life, death, and property defies full account.
units.literal: Beyond that, their power over life, death, grant, and seizure cannot be fully told.

units.zh: 晉州軍敗，後主還鄴，提婆奔周軍。
units.en: After the defeat at Jinzhou, as the Later Lord fled to Ye, Tipo defected to the Zhou.
units.literal: When the Jinzhou army was defeated and the Later Lord returned to Ye, Tipo fled to the Zhou army.

units.zh: 令萱自殺，子孫大小皆棄市，籍沒其家。
units.en: Lingxuan took her own life; her family, young and old, was executed in the marketplace and their property seized.
units.literal: Lingxuan killed herself; descendants great and small were all executed in the marketplace, and their household was registered and confiscated.

units.zh: 高阿那肱，善無人也。
units.en: Gao Anagujin was a native of Shanwu.
units.literal: Gao Anagujin was a native of Shanwu.

units.zh: 其父市貴，從高祖起義。
units.en: His father Shigui had followed Gaozu in the founding uprising.
units.literal: His father Shigui followed Gaozu in raising the righteous army.

units.zh: 那肱為庫典，從征討，以功勤擢為武衛將軍。
units.en: Anagujin began as a storehouse clerk, campaigned with the army, and rose to General of Martial Guards for his service.
units.literal: Anagujin served as a storehouse clerk; he followed campaigns and, for meritorious exertion, was promoted to General of Martial Guards.

units.zh: 肱妙於騎射，便僻善事人，每宴射之次，大為世祖所愛重。
units.en: Expert at mounted archery and winning favor, he was a favorite at Shizu's hunts and banquets.
units.literal: Anagujin was skilled at mounted archery and adept at pleasing people; at each banquet and archery contest he was greatly loved and esteemed by Shizu.

units.zh: 又諂悅和士開，尤相褻狎，士開每為之言，彌見親待。
units.en: He fawned on He Shikai and grew especially close; Shikai's patronage brought him ever greater favor.
units.literal: He also fawned on He Shikai and was especially intimate with him; Shikai often spoke for him, and he grew all the more personally favored.

units.zh: 後主卽位，累遷幷省尚書左僕射，封淮陰王，又除幷省尚書令。
units.en: Under the Later Lord he rose to Left Vice Director and then Director of the Combined Provinces Department of State Affairs and Prince of Huaiyin.
units.literal: When the Later Lord ascended the throne, Anagujin was repeatedly promoted to Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs of the Combined Provinces, enfeoffed as Prince of Huaiyin, and then appointed Director of the Department of State Affairs of the Combined Provinces.

units.zh: 肱才伎庸劣，不涉文史，識用尤在士開之下，而姦巧計數亦不逮士開。
units.en: Mediocre in talent and ignorant of letters, he was duller and less cunning even than Shikai.
units.literal: Anagujin's talent and skill were mediocre and inferior; he did not touch literary or historical learning, and his discernment and ability were especially below Shikai's, while his cunning calculation also fell short of Shikai's.

units.zh: 旣為世祖所幸，多令在東宮侍後主，所以大被寵遇。
units.en: Shizu had favored him and kept him in the Eastern Palace with the young heir, which won him lasting preferment.
units.literal: Because he had been favored by Shizu, he was often kept in the Eastern Palace attending the Later Lord, and for this reason was greatly favored.

units.zh: 士開死後，後主謂其識度足繼士開，遂致位宰輔。
units.en: After Shikai's death the Later Lord thought him Shikai's equal and made him chief minister.
units.literal: After Shikai died, the Later Lord considered his discernment sufficient to succeed Shikai, and so raised him to chief minister.

units.zh: 武平四年，令其錄尚書事，又總知外兵及內省機密。
units.en: In Wuping 4 he became Chief Recorder, commanding external armies and inner-palace secrets.
units.literal: In Wuping 4 he was ordered to serve as Chief Recorder of the Department of State Affairs and also to oversee external military affairs and inner-palace secrets.

units.zh: 尚書郎中源師嘗諮肱云：「龍見，當雩。」
units.en: Yuan Shi of the Department of State Affairs told Anagujin, "A dragon has appeared—we must perform a rain sacrifice."
units.literal: Director of the Department of State Affairs Yuan Shi once consulted Anagujin, saying, "A dragon has appeared—we should perform a rain sacrifice."

units.zh: 問師云：「何處龍見？
units.en: Anagujin asked, "Where was it seen?
units.literal: Anagujin asked, "Where did the dragon appear?

units.zh: 作何物顏色？」
units.en: What color was it?"
units.literal: What did it look like?"

units.zh: 師云：「此是龍星見，須雩祭，非是真龍見。」
units.en: Shi said, "It is the dragon star, not a real dragon—we need a rain rite, not a dragon hunt."
units.literal: Shi said, "This is the dragon star appearing—we must perform the rain sacrifice; it is not a real dragon appearing."

units.zh: 肱云：「漢兒強知星宿！」
units.en: Anagujin snapped, "Han dogs playing astronomer!"
units.literal: Anagujin said, "These Han dogs pretend to know the stars!"

units.zh: 其墻面如此。
units.en: Such was his brazen ignorance.
units.literal: His shamelessness was like this.

units.zh: 又為右丞相，餘如故。
units.en: He was also made Right Chancellor; his other posts remained unchanged.
units.literal: He was also made Right Chancellor; the rest remained as before.

units.zh: 周師逼平陽，後主於天池校獵，晉州頻遣馳奏，從旦至午，驛馬三至，肱云：「大家正作樂，何急奏聞。」
units.en: While Zhou armies closed on Pingyang, the Later Lord hunted at Tianchi; Jinzhou sent three urgent dispatches by noon, and Anagujin said, "His Majesty is at play—why the alarm?"
units.literal: When Zhou forces pressed Pingyang, the Later Lord was hunting at Tianchi; Jinzhou repeatedly sent urgent dispatches—from dawn till noon the relay horses came three times—and Anagujin said, "His Majesty is just enjoying himself; why the urgent reports?"

units.zh: 至暮，使更至，云：「平陽城已陷，賊方至。」
units.en: At dusk another rider reported, "Pingyang has fallen and the enemy is near."
units.literal: At evening another messenger came, saying, "Pingyang city has fallen and the enemy is approaching."

units.zh: 乃奏知。
units.en: Only then did he inform the emperor.
units.literal: Only then was it reported to the emperor.

units.zh: 明早旦，卽欲引軍，淑妃又請更合一圍。
units.en: At dawn he prepared to march, but the Shufei begged for one more hunt.
units.literal: Early the next morning he was about to lead the army away, but the Shufei asked for one more round of the hunt.

units.zh: 及軍赴晉州，令肱率前軍先進，仍總節度諸軍。
units.en: Marching on Jinzhou, Anagujin led the vanguard and overall command.
units.literal: When the army set out for Jinzhou, Anagujin was ordered to lead the vanguard and still to command all the armies overall.

units.zh: 後主謂肱曰：「戰是耶，不戰是耶？」
units.en: The Later Lord asked, "Do we fight or not?"
units.literal: The Later Lord asked Anagujin, "Fight or not fight?"

units.zh: 肱曰：「勿戰，卻守高梁橋。」
units.en: Anagujin said, "Do not fight—fall back to Gaoliang Bridge."
units.literal: Anagujin said, "Do not fight—withdraw and hold Gaoliang Bridge."

units.zh: 安吐根曰：「一把子賊，馬上刺取擲著汾河中。」
units.en: Antugen said, "A handful of bandits—spear them from horseback and toss them in the Fen."
units.literal: Antugen said, "A handful of bandits—spear them from horseback and throw them into the Fen River."

units.zh: 帝意未決。
units.en: The emperor could not decide.
units.literal: The emperor's mind was not yet decided.

units.zh: 諸內參曰：「彼亦天子，我亦天子，彼尚能遠來，我何為守塹示弱？」
units.en: Inner attendants said, "They are emperors and so are we—they came from afar; why cower behind ditches?"
units.literal: The inner attendants said, "They are an emperor too and we are emperors too—they came from far away; why should we hold the trenches and show weakness?"

units.zh: 帝曰：「此言是也。」
units.en: The emperor said, "They are right."
units.literal: The emperor said, "That saying is right."

units.zh: 於是漸進。
units.en: The army moved forward.
units.literal: And so they advanced gradually.

units.zh: 提婆觀戰，東偏頗有退者，提婆去曰：「大家去！
units.en: Tipo watched the battle; as the eastern wing buckled he shouted, "Your Majesty, go!
units.literal: Tipo watched the battle; on the eastern wing there was considerable retreat, and Tipo cried, "His Majesty, go!

units.zh: 大家去！」
units.en: Go, Your Majesty!"
units.literal: His Majesty, go!"

units.zh: 帝以淑妃奔高梁關。
units.en: The emperor fled with the Shufei toward Gaoliang Pass.
units.literal: The emperor fled with the Shufei toward Gaoliang Pass.

units.zh: 開府奚長樂諫曰：「半進半退，戰之常體，今兵衆全整，未有傷敗，陛下舍此安之？
units.en: Grand Prefect Xi Changle urged, "Armies ebb and flow—ours is still intact. Where will Your Majesty go if you leave now?
units.literal: Grand Prefect Xi Changle remonstrated, "Half advance and half retreat is the normal form of battle; now the troops are wholly intact and none are wounded or defeated—where will Your Majesty go if you abandon this?

units.zh: 御馬一動，人情驚亂，且速還安慰之。」
units.en: If Your Majesty's horse moves, panic will spread—turn back at once and steady the men."
units.literal: Once the imperial horse moves, hearts will panic in disorder; return quickly and reassure them."

units.zh: 武衛張常山自後至，亦曰：「軍尋收回，甚整頓，圍城兵亦不動，至尊宜回，不信臣言，乞將內參往視。」
units.en: Martial Guard Zhang Changshan added, "The army is withdrawing in good order and the siege lines hold—Your Majesty should return; if you doubt me, send attendants to see."
units.literal: Martial Guard Zhang Changshan arrived from behind and also said, "The army is withdrawing in good order and is very well arrayed; the besieging troops are not moving either—Your Majesty should turn back; if you do not believe me, I beg to take inner attendants to look."

units.zh: 帝將從之。
units.en: The emperor was about to heed them.
units.literal: The emperor was about to agree.

units.zh: 提婆引帝肘曰：「此言難信。」
units.en: Tipo tugged the emperor's arm and said, "Do not trust them."
units.literal: Tipo pulled the emperor's elbow and said, "These words are hard to believe."

units.zh: 帝遂北馳。
units.en: The emperor galloped north.
units.literal: The emperor then fled north at a gallop.

units.zh: 有軍士告稱那肱遣臣招引西軍，今故聞奏。
units.en: A soldier reported that Anagujin had sent him to summon Zhou forces.
units.literal: A soldier reported that Anagujin had sent him to summon the western army, and for that reason now reported it.

units.zh: 後主令侍中斛律孝卿檢校，孝卿云：「此人妄語。」
units.en: The Later Lord had Attendant Hulu Xiaoqing investigate; Xiaoqing said, "This man speaks falsely."
units.literal: The Later Lord ordered Attendant-in-Ordinary Hulu Xiaoqing to investigate; Xiaoqing said, "This man speaks falsely."

units.zh: 還至晉，那肱腹心告肱謀反，又以為妄，斬之。
units.en: Back at Jin, a confidant accused Anagujin of treason; again the charge was dismissed and the accuser executed.
units.literal: Returning to Jin, Anagujin's confidant reported that Anagujin was plotting rebellion; again it was judged false, and the informant was executed.

units.zh: 乃顛沛還鄴，侍衛逃散，唯那肱及內官數十騎從行。
units.en: They fled in disorder to Ye; the guard scattered, and only Anagujin and a few dozen inner attendants rode with the emperor.
units.literal: Then in distress they returned to Ye; the guard scattered and fled, and only Anagujin and a few dozen inner attendants on horseback followed.

units.zh: 後主走度太行，令那肱以數千人投濟州關，仍遣覘候。
units.en: Crossing the Taihang, the Later Lord sent Anagujin with several thousand men to Jizhou Pass and ordered scouts ahead.
units.literal: The Later Lord fled over the Taihang Mountains and ordered Anagujin to take several thousand men to Jizhou Pass, still sending scouts ahead.

units.zh: 每奏：「周軍未至，且在青州集兵，未須南行。」
units.en: Each report said, "Zhou troops are not yet here—raise men at Qingzhou; no need to flee south yet."
units.literal: Each report said, "Zhou troops have not yet arrived; gather troops at Qingzhou first—there is no need to go south yet."

units.zh: 及周將軍尉遲迥至關，肱遂降。
units.en: When Zhou General Yuchi Jiong reached the pass, Anagujin surrendered.
units.literal: When Zhou General Yuchi Jiong reached the pass, Anagujin surrendered.

units.zh: 時人皆云肱表款周武，必仰生致齊主，故不速報兵至，使後主被擒。
units.en: Contemporaries said Anagujin had pledged to Zhou and delayed reporting the enemy so the Qi ruler could be taken alive.
units.literal: People of the time all said Anagujin had pledged himself to Emperor Wu of Zhou and surely hoped to deliver the Qi ruler alive, and so did not quickly report the enemy's arrival, causing the Later Lord to be captured.

units.zh: 肱至長安，授大將軍，封郡公，為隆州刺史，誅。
units.en: In Chang'an he was made Grand General and a commandery duke, then Governor of Longzhou—and executed.
units.literal: Anagujin reached Chang'an, was appointed Grand General, enfeoffed as Duke of a commandery, made Governor of Longzhou, and was executed.

units.zh: 初，天保中，顯祖自晉陽還鄴，陽愚僧阿禿師於路中大叫，呼顯祖姓名云：「阿那瓌終破你國。」
units.en: In Tianbao, as Xianzu returned from Jinyang to Ye, the monk Atuo of Yangyu shouted his name on the road: "Anagujin will destroy your state."
units.literal: Earlier, in Tianbao, Xianzu was returning from Jinyang to Ye when the monk Atuo of Yangyu shouted along the road, calling Xianzu by name and saying, "Anagujin will in the end destroy your state."

units.zh: 是時茹茹主阿那瑰在塞北強盛，顯祖尤忌之，所以每歲討擊，後亡齊者遂屬阿那肱云。
units.en: The Rouran ruler Anagujin then dominated the northern frontier and Xianzu feared him; years later Qi's destroyer proved to be Gao Anagujin.
units.literal: At that time the Rouran ruler Anagujin was powerful north of the frontier and Xianzu especially feared him, and so every year launched punitive campaigns; later the destroyer of Qi turned out to be Anagujin, it is said.

units.zh: 雖作「肱」字，世人皆稱為「瓌」音，斯固「亡秦者胡」，蓋懸定於窈冥也。
units.en: Though written with the character for "gujin," all pronounced it like "gui"—as if fate had already whispered, "He who destroys Qin is the Hu."
units.literal: Though the character is written "gujin," everyone pronounced it like "gui"; this is indeed like "the one who will destroy Qin is the Hu"—fixed in the dark beyond.

units.zh: 韓鳳，字長鸞，昌黎人也。
units.en: Han Feng, styled Changluan, was from Changli.
units.literal: Han Feng, courtesy name Changluan, was a native of Changli.

units.zh: 父永興，青州刺史。
units.en: His father Yongxing had been Inspector of Qingzhou.
units.literal: His father Yongxing was Inspector of Qingzhou.

units.zh: 鳳少而聰察，有膂力，善騎射。
units.en: From youth Feng was sharp-eyed and strong, skilled at mounted archery.
units.literal: Feng from youth was perceptive and keen, had physical strength, and was skilled at mounted archery.

units.zh: 稍遷都督。
units.en: He rose gradually to Area Commander.
units.literal: He was gradually promoted to Area Commander.

units.zh: 後主居東宮，年幼稚，世祖簡都督二十人送令侍衛，鳳在其數。
units.en: While the young Later Lord lived in the Eastern Palace, Shizu chose twenty area commanders to guard him; Feng was one.
units.literal: When the Later Lord lived in the Eastern Palace and was still young, Shizu selected twenty area commanders and sent them to attend and guard him; Feng was among them.

units.zh: 後主親就衆中牽鳳手曰：「都督看兒來。」
units.en: The prince went among them, took Feng's hand, and said, "Commander, look after my boy."
units.literal: The Later Lord personally went among the crowd, took Feng's hand, and said, "Area Commander, look at my boy."

units.zh: 因此被識，數喚共戲。
units.en: Feng was remembered and often called to play with him.
units.literal: From this he came to be recognized and was repeatedly summoned to play together.

units.zh: 後主卽位，累遷侍中、領軍，總知內省機密。
units.en: When the Later Lord took the throne, Feng rose to Attendant-in-Ordinary and Army Director with charge of inner secrets.
units.literal: When the Later Lord ascended the throne, Feng was repeatedly promoted to Attendant-in-Ordinary and Army Director, overseeing inner-palace secrets.

units.zh: 祖珽曾與鳳於後主前論事。
units.en: Zu Ting once debated policy with Feng before the Later Lord.
units.literal: Zu Ting once debated affairs with Feng before the Later Lord.

units.zh: 語鳳云：「強弓長槊，無容相謝，軍國謀算，何由得爭。」
units.en: Zu said, "Strong bow and long spear admit no yielding—how can we compete in statecraft?"
units.literal: He said to Feng, "Strong bow and long spear—there is no room for yielding; in military and state planning, how can we compete?"

units.zh: 鳳答曰：「各出意見，豈在文武優劣？」
units.en: Feng replied, "Each speaks his mind—what has civil or military rank to do with it?"
units.literal: Feng answered, "Each gives his opinion—what has that to do with whether civil or military is superior?"

units.zh: 封昌黎郡王。
units.en: He was made Prince of Changli Commandery.
units.literal: He was enfeoffed as Prince of Changli Commandery.

units.zh: 男寶仁尚公主，在晉陽賜第一區。
units.en: His son Baoren married a princess and received a premier residence in Jinyang.
units.literal: His son Baoren married a princess and was granted a first-rank residence in Jinyang.

units.zh: 其公主生男滿月，駕幸鳳宅，宴會盡日。
units.en: When the princess's son reached his first month, the emperor visited Feng's house and feasted all day.
units.literal: When the princess bore a son and the full month was completed, the imperial carriage visited Feng's house and feasted all day.

units.zh: 軍國要密，無不經手，與高阿那肱、穆提婆共處衡軸，號曰三貴，損國害政，日月滋甚。
units.en: Every state secret passed through his hands; with Gao Anagujin and Mu Tipo he formed the "Three Nobles" at the helm, ruining government daily.
units.literal: No military or state secret failed to pass through his hands; together with Gao Anagujin and Mu Tipo he stood at the pivot of power, called the Three Nobles, harming the state and ruining government day by day.

units.zh: 壽陽陷沒，鳳與穆提婆聞告敗，握槊不輟，曰：「他家物，從他去。」
units.en: When Shouyang fell, Feng and Mu Tipo kept playing polo and said, "Another man's loss—let it go."
units.literal: When Shouyang fell, Feng and Mu Tipo heard the report of defeat yet did not stop playing polo, saying, "Another man's property—let it go."

units.zh: 後帝使於黎陽臨河築城戍，曰：「急時且守此作龜茲國子，更可憐人生如寄，唯當行樂，何因愁為？」
units.en: Later the emperor sent him to build a fortress at Liyang on the river and said, "In a pinch we can hold this and play at being princes of Kucha; human life is but a sojourn—one should only seek pleasure; why grieve?"
units.literal: Later the emperor sent him to build a riverside fortress at Liyang and said, "In an emergency we can hold this and play the princes of Kucha; how much more pitiable that human life is a lodging—one should only seek pleasure; why grieve?"

units.zh: 君臣應和若此。
units.en: Emperor and ministers spoke in such terms.
units.literal: Ruler and ministers echoed one another like this.

units.zh: 其弟萬歲，及二子寶行、寶信並開府儀同。
units.en: His brother Wansui and sons Baoxing and Baoxin all received the rank of Grand Prefect.
units.literal: His younger brother Wansui and his two sons Baoxing and Baoxin were all made Grand Prefects with the rank of a consort's kin.

units.zh: 寶信尚公主，駕復幸其宅，親戚咸蒙官賞。
units.en: Baoxin married a princess; the emperor visited again and kinsmen were showered with offices and gifts.
units.literal: Baoxin married a princess; the imperial carriage again visited his house, and relatives all received offices and rewards.

units.zh: 鳳母鮮于，段孝言之從母子姊也，為此偏相參附，奏遣監造晉陽宮。
units.en: Feng's mother Xianyu was Duan Xiaoyan's maternal cousin; Feng favored Xiaoyan and had him sent to supervise the Jinyang palace.
units.literal: Feng's mother Xianyu was a cousin on the mother's side of Duan Xiaoyan; for this reason he was especially attached to Xiaoyan and memorialized to send him to supervise construction of the Jinyang palace.

units.zh: 陳德信馳驛檢行，見孝言役官夫匠自營宅，卽語云：「僕射為至尊起臺殿未訖，何容先自營造？」
units.en: Chen Dexin inspected by post relay and found Xiaoyan using state laborers on a private house; he said, "The Vice Director has not finished the emperor's halls—how can he build his own first?"
units.literal: Chen Dexin rode post-horses to inspect the work and saw Xiaoyan using official laborers and craftsmen to build his own house; he immediately said, "The Vice Director is building halls and towers for His Majesty and they are not yet finished—how can he first build for himself?"

units.zh: 鳳及穆提婆亦遣孝言分工匠為己造宅，德信還具奏聞。
units.en: Feng and Mu Tipo had Xiaoyan assign craftsmen to build their houses; Dexin reported it all to the throne.
units.literal: Feng and Mu Tipo also sent Xiaoyan to assign craftsmen to build mansions for themselves; Dexin returned and fully reported this to the throne.

units.zh: 及幸晉陽，又以官馬與他人乘騎。
units.en: On the Jinyang trip he again let others ride official horses.
units.literal: When the emperor visited Jinyang, he again lent official horses for others to ride.

units.zh: 上因此發忿，與提婆並除名，亦不露其罪。
units.en: The emperor struck Feng and Tipo from the rolls in anger but did not publish their crimes.
units.literal: The emperor therefore grew angry and struck both names from the rolls together with Tipo, yet did not expose their crimes.

units.zh: 仍毀其宅。
units.en: Their mansions were demolished.
units.literal: He still destroyed their mansions.

units.zh: 公主離婚。
units.en: The princess divorced him.
units.literal: The princess divorced him.

units.zh: 復被遣向鄴吏部門參。
units.en: He was sent to report at the Ye personnel office.
units.literal: He was again sent to attend at the Ministry of Personnel gate in Ye.

units.zh: 及後主晉陽走還，被勑入內，尋詔復爵。
units.en: When the Later Lord fled back from Jinyang, Feng was summoned in and soon restored to rank.
units.literal: When the Later Lord fled back from Jinyang, he was ordered into the palace and soon an edict restored his title.

units.zh: 從後主走度河，到青州，並為周軍所獲。
units.en: He fled with the Later Lord to Qing Province and was taken by Zhou troops.
units.literal: Following the Later Lord in flight across the river to Qing Province, he was captured together by Zhou troops.

units.zh: 鳳於權要之中，尤嫉人士，崔季舒等冤酷，皆鳳所為。
units.en: Feng hated the gentry above all; Cui Jishu’s cruel fate was his work.
units.literal: Among those in power Feng especially hated the gentry; the cruel wrongs done to Cui Jishu and others were all Feng’s doing.

units.zh: 每朝士諮事，莫敢仰視，動致呵叱，輒詈云：「狗漢大不可耐，唯須殺却。」
units.en: Courtiers dared not meet his eye; he roared at them, “These damned Hans ought to be killed.”
units.literal: Whenever court gentlemen came to consult him, none dared look up; he always shouted them down and would curse, “Damned Han—utterly unbearable; they ought only to be killed.”

units.zh: 若見武職，雖廝養末品亦容下之。
units.en: Soldiers, even the lowest ranks, he treated with respect.
units.literal: If he saw military men, even the lowest camp servants, he would treat them with forbearance.

units.zh: 仕隋，位終於隴州刺史。
units.en: Under Sui he died inspector of Long Province.
units.literal: Serving Sui, he ended his career as Inspector of Long Province.

units.zh: 韓寶業、盧勒叉、齊紹，並高祖舊左右，唯門閹驅使，不被恩遇。
units.en: Han Baoye, Lu Lecha, and Qi Shao had been Gaozu’s gate eunuchs, never favored.
units.literal: Han Baoye, Lu Lecha, and Qi Shao were all old attendants of Gaozu, mere gate eunuchs for errands, unrewarded with favor.

units.zh: 歷天保、皇建之朝，亦不至寵幸，但漸有職任。
units.en: Through Tianbao and Huangjian they gained office but not favor.
units.literal: Through the Tianbao and Huangjian reigns they still did not reach favor, but gradually gained offices.

units.zh: 寶業至長秋卿，勒叉等或為中常侍。
units.en: Baoye became director of the Long Autumn Palace; Lecha and others became palace attendants.
units.literal: Baoye reached Director of the Long Autumn Palace; Lecha and others sometimes became palace regular attendants.

units.zh: 世祖時有曹文摽、鄧長顒輩，亦有至儀同食幹者，唯長顒武平中任參宰相，干預朝權。
units.en: Under Shizu, Cao Wenbiao and Deng Changyang rose high; only Changyang in Wuping shared in governing.
units.literal: In Shizu’s time there were Cao Wenbiao, Deng Changyang, and others; some even reached provisioners of the same rank as the emperor’s meals; only Changyang in the Wuping era served as associate of the chancellor and meddled in court power.

units.zh: 後寶業、勒叉、齊紹、子徵並封王，不過侵暴。
units.en: Later Baoye, Lecha, Shao, and Zizheng were made princes and lived by plunder.
units.literal: Later Baoye, Lecha, Shao, and Zizheng were all enfeoffed as princes—nothing more than violent oppression.

units.zh: 於後主之朝，有陳德信等數十人，並肆其姦佞，敗政虐人，古今未有。
units.en: Under the Later Lord, dozens like Chen Dexin ruined the state as never before.
units.literal: In the Later Lord’s court dozens like Chen Dexin practiced flattery and wickedness, ruining government and tormenting the people—unprecedented in old or new times.

units.zh: 多授開府，罕止儀同，亦有加光祿大夫，金章紫綬者。
units.en: Most became directors of ceremonial parallels; some even grandees with golden seals.
units.literal: Most were appointed directors of the Bureau of Ceremonial Parallels; few stopped at ceremonial peers; some were even advanced to Grand Master of Palace Leisure with golden seals and purple cords.

units.zh: 多帶侍中、中常侍，此二職乃數十人，又皆封王、開府。
units.en: Dozens held attendant posts—and every one was a prince or director of ceremonial parallels.
units.literal: Many bore the posts of palace attendant or palace regular attendant—these two offices numbered dozens of men, and all were enfeoffed princes or directors of the Bureau of Ceremonial Parallels.

units.zh: 恒出入門禁，往來園苑，趨侍左右，通宵累日。
units.en: They haunted palace gates and gardens, attending the emperor day and night.
units.literal: They constantly passed in and out of the palace gates, coming and going in the parks and gardens, hurrying to wait on the emperor’s left and right, all night and day without cease.

units.zh: 承候顏色，競進諂諛，莫不發言動意，多會深旨。
units.en: They read his mood and flattered him, almost always hitting his intent.
units.literal: Receiving his expression, they vied in flattery; none failed to speak and act in ways that mostly matched his deepest intent.

units.zh: 一戲之賞，動逾巨萬，丘山之積，貪吝無厭。
units.en: One jest could bring tens of thousands; they hoarded without end.
units.literal: A reward for one jest exceeded tens of thousands; mountains of wealth—and still they were greedy without end.

units.zh: 猶以波斯狗為儀同、郡君，分其幹祿。
units.en: They even ennobled a Persian dog as ceremonial peer and gave it a stipend.
units.literal: They even made a Persian dog a ceremonial peer and commandery lady, sharing out its stipends.

units.zh: 神獸門外有朝貴憩息之所，時人號為解卸廳。
units.en: Outside the Divine Beast Gate was the courtiers’ rest hall, called the Hall of Unburdening.
units.literal: Outside the Divine Beast Gate was a place where court nobles rested; people of the time called it the Hall of Unburdening.

units.zh: 諸閹或在內多日，暫放歸休，所乘之馬牽至神獸門階，然後升騎，飛鞭競走，數十為羣，馬塵必坌。
units.en: Eunuchs released from duty raced their horses from the Divine Beast Gate in dusty packs of dozens.
units.literal: When eunuchs who had been inside many days were briefly released to rest, the horses they rode were led to the Divine Beast Gate steps; then they mounted, whipped their horses, and raced off in groups of dozens, raising clouds of dust.

units.zh: 諸朝貴爰至唐、趙、韓、駱皆隱聽趨避，不敢為言。
units.en: Even great clans hid and gave way, daring not protest.
units.literal: Court nobles even of the Tang, Zhao, Han, and Luo clans would hide and listen and give way, not daring to speak.

units.zh: 高祖時有蒼頭陳山提、蓋豐樂、劉桃枝等數十人，俱驅馳便僻，頗蒙恩遇。
units.en: Gaozu favored dozens of runners like Chen Shanti, Gai Fengle, and Liu Taozhi.
units.literal: In Gaozu’s time there were dozens of household slaves such as Chen Shanti, Gai Fengle, and Liu Taozhi—all nimble runners and flatterers who received considerable favor.

units.zh: 天保、大寧之朝，漸以貴盛，至武平時皆以開府、封王，其不及武平者則追贈王爵。
units.en: By Wuping they were all princes and directors of ceremonial parallels; the dead were posthumously ennobled.
units.literal: In the Tianbao and Daning reigns they gradually grew exalted; by Wuping all were directors of the Bureau of Ceremonial Parallels and enfeoffed princes; those who did not reach Wuping were posthumously given princely titles.

units.zh: 又有何海及子洪珍皆為王，尤為親要。
units.en: He Hai and his son Hongzhen were made princes and especially favored.
units.literal: There were also He Hai and his son Hongzhen, both made princes, especially intimate and powerful.

units.zh: 洪珍侮弄權勢，鬻獄賣官。
units.en: Hongzhen sold offices and judgments.
units.literal: Hongzhen toyed with power, selling judgments and offices.

units.zh: 又有史醜多之徒胡小兒等數十，咸能舞工歌，亦至儀同、開府封王。
units.en: Dozens of Hu performers like Shi Chouduo rose to ceremonial peers and princedoms.
units.literal: There were also dozens of Hu boys such as Shi Chouduo who could dance and sing and likewise reached ceremonial peers, directors of the Bureau of Ceremonial Parallels, and princely enfeoffment.

units.zh: 諸宦者猶以宮掖驅馳，便煩左右，漸因昵狎，以至大官。
units.en: Eunuchs who served in the inner palace rose through intimacy to high rank.
units.literal: The eunuchs still served in the inner palace and, because they were handy at the emperor’s side, gradually through intimacy reached high office.

units.zh: 蒼頭始自家人，情寄深密，及於後主，則是先朝舊人，以勤舊之勞，致此叨竊。
units.en: Slaves who began as family servants rose under the Later Lord through old service.
units.literal: Household slaves began as family servants with deep personal ties; under the Later Lord they were men of the former reign, and through merit of long service attained this usurped glory.

units.zh: 至於胡小兒等眼鼻深險，一無可用，非理愛好，排突朝貴，尤為人士之所疾惡。
units.en: Useless Hu favorites with deep-set features shoved aside nobles and were loathed by the gentry.
units.literal: As for Hu boys and the like, with deep-set eyes and noses, utterly useless, irrationally favored, they shoved aside court nobles and were especially hated by the gentry.

units.zh: 其以音樂至大官者：沈過兒官至開府儀同，王長通年十四五，便假節通州刺史。
units.en: Musicians rose highest: Shen Guo’er became director of ceremonial parallels; Wang Changtong at fifteen was acting inspector of Tong.
units.literal: Those who reached high office through music: Shen Guo’er reached Director of the Bureau of Ceremonial Parallels; Wang Changtong at fourteen or fifteen was made acting Inspector of Tong Province.

units.zh: 時又有開府薛榮宗，常自云能使鬼。
units.en: Xue Rongzong, a director of ceremonial parallels, claimed he could command ghosts.
units.literal: At that time there was also Director of the Bureau of Ceremonial Parallels Xue Rongzong, who constantly claimed he could command ghosts.

units.zh: 及周兵之逼，言於後主曰：「臣已發遣斛律明月將大兵在前去。」
units.en: As Zhou troops closed in, he told the Later Lord, “I have sent Hulu Guang ahead with a great army.”
units.literal: When Zhou troops pressed close, he told the Later Lord, “Your servant has already sent Hulu Guang with a great army ahead.”

units.zh: 帝信之。
units.en: The emperor believed him.
units.literal: The emperor believed him.

units.zh: 經古冢，榮宗謂舍人元行恭是誰冢，行恭戲之曰：「林宗冢。」
units.en: Passing a tomb, Rongzong asked whose it was; Xinggong jested, “Lin Zong’s.”
units.literal: Passing an ancient tomb, Rongzong asked the attendant Yuan Xinggong whose tomb it was; Xinggong jested, “Lin Zong’s tomb.”

units.zh: 復問林宗是誰，行恭曰：「郭元貞父。」
units.en: Asked who Lin Zong was, Xinggong said, “Guo Yuanzhen’s father.”
units.literal: He asked again who Lin Zong was; Xinggong said, “Guo Yuanzhen’s father.”

units.zh: 榮宗前奏曰：「臣向見郭林宗從冢出，著大帽，吉莫靴，插馬鞭，問臣『我阿貞來不』。」
units.en: Rongzong reported, “I saw Guo Lin Zong leave the tomb in a great hat and boots, whip in hand, asking if his A Zhen had come.”
units.literal: Rongzong memorialized, “Your servant just now saw Guo Lin Zong come out of the tomb wearing a great hat, boots of jimo, with a horsewhip stuck in his belt, asking me, ‘Has my A Zhen come?’”

units.zh: 是時羣妄多皆類此。
units.en: Mad tales of this sort were common.
units.literal: At that time many of the crowd’s mad tales were of this sort.

units.zh: 贊曰：危亡之祚，昏亂之朝，小人道長，君子道消。
units.en: Appraisal: In a dying mandate and a chaotic court, petty men flourish and gentlemen fade.
units.literal: The appraisal says: In a mandate about to perish, in a court of confusion, the way of petty men grows long and the way of gentlemen wanes.

units.zh: 武成崩，尊為皇太后，陸媼及和士開密謀殺趙郡王叡，出婁定遠、高文遙為刺史。
units.en: When Wucheng died she was honored as Empress Dowager; Nurse Lu and He Shikai secretly plotted to kill Prince Rui of Zhao Commandery and sent out Lou Dingyuan and Gao Wenyao as governors.
units.literal: When Wucheng died she was honored as Empress Dowager; Nurse Lu and He Shikai secretly plotted to kill Prince Rui of Zhao Commandery and sent out Lou Dingyuan and Gao Wenyao as governors.

units.zh: 蠕蠕主阿那瓌亡破來奔，朝廷矜之，送復其國。
units.en: Anagui, ruler of the Rouran, fled to the court after his state was destroyed; the court took pity on him and helped restore his kingdom.
units.literal: The Rouran ruler Anagui, destroyed and fleeing, came to surrender; the court took pity on him and sent him back to restore his state.

units.zh: 躍為朝臣書與瓌，陳以禍福，言辭甚美。
units.en: Yue drafted a letter from the court ministers to Anagui, explaining the consequences of fortune and disaster in language of exceptional elegance.
units.literal: Yue wrote on behalf of the court ministers to Gui, setting forth fortune and calamity; the language was very fine.

units.zh: 既而每使朝貢，辭旨頗不盡禮。
units.en: Afterward, whenever he sent tribute missions, their language was often less than fully respectful.
units.literal: Thereafter, whenever he sent tribute missions, their wording was rather lacking in courtesy.

units.zh: 袁躍，字景騰，陳郡人，尚書翻弟也。
units.en: Yuan Yue, whose style was Jingteng, came from Chen commandery and was the younger brother of Minister Yuan Fan.
units.literal: Yuan Yue, style name Jingteng, was a man of Chen commandery and the younger brother of Minister Yuan Fan.

units.zh: 魏孝靜在昭陽殿引見。
units.en: Emperor Xiaojing of Wei received them in the Zhaoyang Hall.
units.literal: Emperor Xiaojing of Wei received them at the Zhaoyang Hall.

units.zh: 魏帝宴於華林園，謂高祖曰：「自頃朝貴、牧守令長、所在百司多有貪暴，侵削下人。
units.en: The Wei emperor feasted at Hualin Garden and said to Gao Huan, "Of late, court nobles, prefects and county chiefs, and the hundred offices in every place have many been greedy and violent, encroaching on inferiors.
units.literal: The Wei emperor feasted at Hualin Garden and said to Gao Huan: "Of late, court nobles, prefects and county chiefs, and the hundred offices in every place have many been greedy and violent, encroaching on inferiors.

units.zh: 卽付楊愔進於魏靜帝。
units.en: It was at once given to Yang Yin to present to Emperor Jing of Wei.
units.literal: It was at once handed to Yang Yin to present to Emperor Jing of Wei.

units.zh: 魏靜云：「安置朕何所，復若為去？」
units.en: Emperor Jing said, "Where will you lodge me — and how am I to leave?"
units.literal: Emperor Jing said: "Where will you place me — and how am I to go?"

units.zh: 崔暹，字季倫，博陵安平人，漢尚書寔之後也，世為北州著姓。
units.en: Cui Xian, styled Jilun, was a man of Anping in Boling commandery, a descendant of Cui Shi, Han minister of works, and for generations a leading house of the northern provinces.
units.literal: Cui Xian, styled Jilun, was a man of Anping in Boling commandery, a descendant of Cui Shi, Han Minister of Works, and for generations a prominent clan of the northern provinces.

units.zh: 魏帝便斂容曰：「此事推挹已久，謹當遜避。」
units.en: The Wei emperor composed himself and said, "This has long been pressed upon me — I shall respectfully yield."
units.literal: The Wei emperor drew himself up and said: "This matter has long been pressed upon me — I shall respectfully yield and withdraw."

units.zh: 魏靜帝於是下御坐，就東廊，口詠範蔚宗《後漢書贊》云：「獻生不辰，身播國屯，終我四百，永作虞賓。」
units.en: Emperor Jing of Wei stepped down from the throne, went to the eastern gallery, and recited Fan Ye's encomium from the History of Later Han: "Xian was born untimely, his person cast upon the state's ordeal — ending our four hundred years, forever guest of Yu."
units.literal: Emperor Jing of Wei thereupon stepped down from the imperial seat, went to the eastern gallery, and intoned Fan Ye's encomium from the History of Later Han: "The Emperor Xian was born untimely, his person cast upon the state's ordeal — ending our four hundred years, forever to be guest of Yu."

units.zh: 朝廷之中有用心公平，直言彈劾，不避親戚者，王可勸酒。」
units.en: In the court there are those who apply their hearts with fairness and impeach in straight speech, not avoiding kin—Wang may urge them to drink."
units.literal: In the court there are those who apply their hearts with fairness and impeach in straight speech, not avoiding kin—Wang may urge them to drink."

units.zh: 又道：「若爾，須作詔。」
units.en: He added, "If so, an edict must be made."
units.literal: He added: "If so, an edict must be drafted."

units.zh: 魏靜帝曰：「人念遺簪弊屨，欲與六宮別，可乎？」
units.en: Emperor Jing said, "Men cherish even a lost hairpin or worn shoes — may I bid farewell to the six palaces?"
units.literal: Emperor Jing said: "Men recall even a lost hairpin or worn-out shoes — may I take leave of the six palaces?"

units.zh: 武定六年，甘露降於宮闕，文武官僚同賀顯陽殿。
units.en: In the sixth year of Wuding, sweet dew fell on the palace gates; civil and military officials together offered congratulations at the Xianyang Hall.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Wuding, sweet dew fell upon the palace gates; civil and military officials together offered congratulations at the Xianyang Hall.

units.zh: 受禪之日，除德政為侍中，尋封藍田公。
units.en: On the day the mandate was received, Dezheng was made palace attendant; soon after he was enfeoffed as duke of Lantian.
units.literal: On the day the mandate was received, Dezheng was appointed palace attendant; soon after he was enfeoffed as Duke of Lantian.

units.zh: 亡兄女樂安主，魏帝外甥，內外敬待，勝朕諸妹，思成大兄宿志。」
units.en: My late elder brother's daughter, Princess Le'an, the Wei emperor's niece, honored inside and outside, surpasses my sisters—I think to fulfill my elder brother's longstanding wish."
units.literal: My late elder brother's daughter, Princess Le'an, the Wei emperor's niece, honored inside and outside, surpasses my sisters—I think to fulfill my elder brother's longstanding wish."

units.zh: 魏靜帝登車出萬春門，直長趙道德在車中陪侍，百官在門外拜辭。
units.en: Emperor Jing mounted his carriage and went out the Wanchun Gate; chief controller Zhao Daode attended him in the carriage; the hundred officials bowed farewell outside the gate.
units.literal: Emperor Jing mounted his carriage and went out through the Wanchun Gate; chief controller Zhao Daode attended him in the carriage; the hundred officials bowed farewell outside the gate.

units.zh: 魏帝問僕射崔暹、尚書楊愔等曰：「自古甘露之瑞，漢、魏多少，可各言往代所降之處，德化感致所由。」
units.en: The Wei emperor asked vice director Cui Xian, minister Yang Yin, and others, "Since antiquity the auspice of sweet dew — in Han and Wei, how often? Tell where it fell in past ages and by what moral transformation it was drawn down."
units.literal: The Wei emperor asked Vice Director Cui Xuan, Minister Yang Yin, and others: "Since antiquity the auspice of sweet dew — in Han and Wei, how many times? You may each tell where it fell in past ages and by what moral transformation it was drawn down."

units.zh: 時馮子琮子慈明、祖珽子君信並相繼居中書，故時語云：「馮、祖及趙，穢我鳳池。」
units.en: At the time Feng Zicong's son Ciming and Zu Ting's son Junxin took the secretariat in turn, so people said, "Feng, Zu, and Zhao — they're fouling the phoenix pool."
units.literal: At the time Feng Zicong's son Ciming and Zu Ting's son Junxin in succession held posts in the secretariat, so the saying ran: "Feng, Zu, and Zhao are befouling our phoenix pool."

units.zh: 未幾，爽寢疾，上使巫者薛榮宗視之，雲眾鬼為厲。
units.en: Before long Shuang fell gravely ill. The emperor sent the shaman Xue Rongzong to examine him, and Rongzong reported that a host of ghosts were tormenting him.
units.literal: Before long Shuang took to his bed with illness; the Emperor sent the shaman Xue Rongzong to observe him, who said that many ghosts were causing his affliction.

units.zh: 居數日，有鬼物來擊榮宗，榮宗走下階而斃。
units.en: A few days later ghostly beings attacked Rongzong; he stumbled down the steps and died on the spot.
units.literal: After several days, ghostly things came and struck Rongzong; Rongzong went down the steps and died.

units.zh: 又以霸城縣侯讓其繼母弟孝言。
units.en: He also yielded the marquisate of Bacheng County to his younger half-brother Xiaoyan.
units.literal: He also yielded the marquisate of Bacheng County to his younger half-brother Xiaoyan.

units.zh: 顯祖受禪，別封朝陵縣，又封霸城縣，加位特進。
units.en: When Gao Yang received the abdication, Shao was separately enfeoffed in Chaoling County, again enfeoffed in Bacheng County, and granted special advancement.
units.literal: When the Founding Emperor received the abdication, Shao was separately enfeoffed in Chaoling County, again enfeoffed in Bacheng County, and granted special advancement.

units.zh: 帝詐云鄴中有急，彎弓緾槊，馳入南城，令鄧長顒幽太后北宮，仍有敕內外諸親一不得與太后相見。
units.en: The emperor feigned an emergency in Ye, strung his bow and wrapped his spear, galloped into the southern city, and ordered Deng Changyang to confine the Empress Dowager in the Northern Palace, with an edict forbidding all kin, near or distant, from seeing her.
units.literal: The emperor pretended there was an emergency in Ye, strung his bow and wrapped his spear-shaft, galloped into the southern city, ordered Deng Changyang to confine the Empress Dowager in the Northern Palace, and issued an edict that none of the inner or outer kin might see the Empress Dowager on any account.
